race.description: Kellis Contracting Peter Schumacher Remembrance Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: THIEM (5) made progress last time out, finishing second at the end of 1400m at Dalby after being prominent at the turn. Finds a suitable race and can get the job done. ZOU BIG BOY (1) has been thereabouts without winning, the most recent effort a third at Tamworth over 2100m. Has a high cruising speed and is among the leading chances. HOTZINO (6) went back early from her wide draw over 1630m at this track last time but hit the line strongly to finish fourth. Must be included. SUPER JOHNNY JOYA (11) faded last time to finish tenth over 1400m at Beaudesert after showing good early speed. Can sneak into the finish.
